human.name: Human
human.desc: Adaptable and stubborn. Better prices, better fans.

gutterkin.name: Gutterkin
gutterkin.desc: Rat-folk of the drains. Quick hands, quicker feet, never starve.

stoneblood.name: Stoneblood
stoneblood.desc: Living rock with a furnace heart. Hard to kill, hard to hurry.

fennix.name: Fennix
fennix.desc: Fox-folk performers. Crits come naturally. So does showing off.

ogrekin.name: Ogrekin
ogrekin.desc: Huge, gentle until provoked, then very much not gentle.

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.desc: Glowing scholars from the deep archive. Spells come easily.

bogling.name: Bogling
bogling.desc: Frog-folk of the wet floors. Resistant to poison and bad soup.

clanker.name: Clanker
clanker.desc: Clockwork people. Never thirsty, often oiled.

grimhide.name: Grimhide
grimhide.desc: Tusked hunters from the lower floors. Born for the fight.

none.name: Contestant
none.desc: No class yet. You choose one at the Hall of Callings on Floor 3.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.desc: Fire magic. Burns everything, eventually including your problems.

windcaller.name: Windcaller
windcaller.desc: Wind magic. Cut with gales, ride updrafts, bat arrows aside.

frostweaver.name: Frostweaver
frostweaver.desc: Ice magic. Slow it, freeze it, shatter it.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.desc: Lightning. Fast, loud, jumps between enemies.

earthshaper.name: Earthshaper
earthshaper.desc: Earth magic. Stone fists, walls of rock, and feeling footsteps through the floor.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.desc: Water magic. Lashes, bubbles and never being thirsty again.

bonecaller.name: Bonecaller
bonecaller.desc: Death magic. Raise skeletons, wear bones, drink life.

lightbringer.name: Lightbringer
lightbringer.desc: Light magic. Heals, shields, and a flare in the eyes of the wicked.

hexwright.name: Hexwright
hexwright.desc: Curses. Make enemies miss, weaken and regret.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.desc: Time magic. Speed up, slow down, undo a mistake.

sporesage.name: Spore Sage
sporesage.desc: Nature and poison. Spore clouds, bark skin, food from nowhere.

spellsword.name: Spellsword
spellsword.desc: Blade in one hand, spell in the other. Imbues the weapon with the elements.

plumber.name: Plumber
plumber.desc: A wrench, a plunger and no fear of what’s in the pipes.

paramedic.name: Paramedic
paramedic.desc: Patches people up. Hits surprisingly hard with a defibrillator.

demolitions.name: Demolitions Hobbyist
demolitions.desc: Bombs out of cleaning supplies. Eyebrows optional.

dentist.name: Dentist
dentist.desc: Precise, brutal and very interested in teeth.

repoagent.name: Repo Agent
repoagent.desc: Takes back what’s owed. Including things monsters are holding.

exterminator.name: Exterminator
exterminator.desc: Pest control with a sprayer and a pressure gun.

mallsanta.name: Mall Santa
mallsanta.desc: Big, jolly, armoured in padding. Has a list.

nightsecurity.name: Night Security
nightsecurity.desc: A torch, a baton, and knowing exactly where everyone walks.

collegium.name: The Collegium of Downward Arts
collegium.desc: The mages’ guild. Every element under one leaky roof.

union.name: The Tradesfolk Union
union.desc: Skilled trades. They fix the dungeon, or blow it up, at union rates.

nightshift.name: The Night Shift
nightshift.desc: People who work while everyone else sleeps. They see everything.

caregivers.name: The Caregivers’ Lodge
caregivers.desc: Healers and protectors. Cocoa is free. Advice is not.
